summary: UI-2 + UI-3 parity pack partially validated on Expo web (localhost:3000, mobile viewport 390x844) against the production backend (aged-care-os.emergent.host). PASSING: (a) login cathy@example.com / testpass123 → dashboard renders; heroAmount $6,682 uses IBM Plex Mono SemiBold (fontFamily='"IBM Plex Mono SemiBold", "IBM Plex Mono", Menlo, monospace', fontSize=40px) — but ONLY AFTER `sudo supervisorctl restart expo`; before the restart the same node reported font-family='Fraunces, Georgia, serif' with fontSize=44px + letterSpacing=-1px because Metro was serving a stale bundle. (b) Timeline: [data-testid='timeline-filter-grid'] is present with chips "All | Events | Status Changes | Alerts". (c) Audit screen shows 'Audit Log' title. (d) Notifications tab has zero raw YYYY-MM tokens (regex \b\d{4}-\d{2}\b found nothing on the tab body — humanizeMonths render guard works). (e) Settings → Profile shows [data-testid='profile-phone-input']. (f) Settings → Appearance page renders (System/Light/Dark, Text Size, Reduce motion). (g) More/Profile tab bottom reads 'Sign Out' (capital O). (h) Statement Decoder form renders (Snap / Upload / Paste text tabs; disclaimer & 'Decode it' button visible). (i) Tools index lists all 8 tools with correct plan badges. CRITICAL BLOCKERS: (1) Cathy's account on the LIVE production backend is on the FREE plan, not Family — the dashboard explicitly shows the 'Free plan · Pick a plan to see the rest of your dashboard.' upsell, and Budget Calculator + every other Solo/Family-gated tool shows the 'Paid plan needed → This tool is for Solo and Family plans. Pick a plan to use it.' gate (see /app/frontend/src/components/AITools.tsx line 107-111). Because of that, I could NOT run the required end-to-end tests for Budget Calculator, Classification Self-Check, Contribution Estimator, Provider Price Checker, or Care Plan Reviewer — the 'Show me the budget' / equivalent submit buttons don't render behind the paywall. The review request's assumption that 'cathy is on family plan so all tools are unlocked' is FALSE against the current production backend. (2) Statement Decoder __SAMPLE__ decode did not produce a [data-testid='decoder-results'] block within 45s — the 'Decode it' button remained un-pressed / unresponsive in the captured screenshot after fill + click, so I could not verify the ToolSummary headline, 'Points To Check' section, 'Report This' per-anomaly link, or the tail 'Report An Issue' button on the Statement Decoder result. COPY VIOLATIONS (contractions still present in user-facing UI copy — the 'no contractions' rule is not enforced everywhere): 'What's the budget?' at /app/frontend/app/tools/budget-calc.tsx:49 and :88 (h1 heading, visible in the screenshot behind the paywall gate); 'That's ${amount} across the year' in the ToolSummary body of budget-calc.tsx:153; 'What's changed?' label at /app/frontend/app/tools/reassessment-letter.tsx:132; 'What's the referral for?' placeholder at /app/frontend/app/referrals.tsx:128; 'What's a clinical visit cost typically?' suggested prompt at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/chat.tsx:33; 'Here's where to start' at chat.tsx:163; 'I'm feeling well today' at /app/frontend/app/participant.tsx:31; 'I'm a general Q&A assistant, I cannot see…' at /app/frontend/src/components/AITools.tsx:38. FONT LOADING NOTE: document.fonts reports 'IBM Plex Mono loaded' + 'IBM Plex Mono Medium unloaded' + 'IBM Plex Mono SemiBold unloaded' — the semibold/medium web fonts are declared in app/_layout.tsx (lines 94-96) but the browser never activates them (only the base regular is used). Because the CSS stack falls back through 'IBM Plex Mono' → Menlo → monospace, the visible glyphs are still monospace, but the semibold weight the design calls for is NOT actually rendering with the true IBM Plex Mono SemiBold face. Also unrelated but preexisting: Inter-VariableFont.ttf OTS decode error (font falls back), RN-Web shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings, expo-notifications web listener warning — all cosmetic, all already flagged in iteration_13. Deprecated packages detected: none new. SafeAreaView issues detected: none new.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the 'numbers rendered in Fraunces' initial finding: stale Metro bundle. The source code has heroAmount styled with Fonts.monoSemi and fontSize 40, but the served JS bundle contained an older definition (font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 44px; letter-spacing: -1px — i.e. the heading style). `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` forced a fresh bundle and the number correctly re-rendered in IBM Plex Mono SemiBold family with fontSize 40. Root cause of the 'Paid plan needed' blocker: production /api/me returns plan='free' for cathy@example.com; AITools.tsx renders the paywall gate whenever the tool is not entitled, hiding the actual submit button and result screen — nothing to do with the UI-2 pack itself, this is a test-data mismatch. Root cause of the Statement Decoder __SAMPLE__ hang is undetermined — either the submit handler is entitlement-gated too, or the click did not fire in Playwright (button captured in the screenshot still shows resting label, no spinner). Recommend a manual retry with a slower wait and a network log capture.
